title: An SMS campaign introducing a new collection
caption: Illustrative SMS from the fictional store Luma. It introduces a new collection with a demonstration link and opt-out text. The link is inert and no message is sent.

panels.label: New collection
panels.context: An example of a one-time campaign for an audience that accepts SMS.

messages.text: Luma: explore the new collection at example.com/new. Reply STOP to opt out
